meta_data.base_class: Retrieve a summary of the latest research reports or expert analyses on <specific technology> applications in future smart cities. - applicable for querying literature about various cutting-edge technologies' applications in the smart city domain, for a specific publication year and report type.

tool_template.name: <class>_City_Application_Summary
tool_template.description: Retrieve a summary of the latest research reports or expert analyses on <class> applications in future smart cities.

report_type.description: Type of report to retrieve, being 'research' or 'analysis'.

publication_year.description: The year of publication for the reports. It should be a four-digit year.

region_of_focus.description: Geographical region or city for which the <class> application summary should focus on.

include_trends.description: Whether to include trends and predictions related to <class> applications in future smart cities.

application_domain.description: Specific domain within smart cities, such as transportation, healthcare, or energy, where <class> is applied.

language_preference.description: Preferred language for the summary of the <class> application reports.

data_source.description: Preferred source of data or publication for retrieving the <class> application summary.
